sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
APPROVAL AP-0207: part BR-180; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri); billet grade EN AW-6061-T6; status APPROVED 2024-09-02 (PPAP-2024-077)

findings.why: Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri) has an OPEN 8D on cracks in machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6. BR-180 for STL at TO1 is made from the same billet grade, so the issue is on the material of this part. Moving 40% of the volume to Meccanica C is affected even though its approval AP-0207 is current.
